messages.subject: Marldale v Crayford - strategy and next steps
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

My view on Marldale: liability looks good on the express 320 t/h warranty - their best sustained rate is ~210 t/h on both the weighbridge and the PLC. The battleground will be causation; Crayford will say the feed was out of spec and that Marldale misused/under-maintained the plant.

Proposed plan: (1) Letter of Claim under the TCC protocol this month; (2) instruct a plant engineer to nail the cause of the bearing/toggle failures; (3) get counsel (Harriet Stanford) on quantum, especially the loss-of-profit head which is the most exposed.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
